tools.name: status
tools.description: PC connection, installed programs, project and editor availability.

tools.name: files
tools.description: List one project directory (bounded). Hidden runtime/credential directories are excluded.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a project text file with SHA256 for optimistic write checking. For images use artifact.

tools.name: artifact
tools.description: Check availability of a saved PNG/JPEG. OpenFang 0.6.9 cannot see MCP images: adapter reports human visual review required and omits base64.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write project text under scenes/scripts/assets/obi_checks, checking expected_sha256 (NEW for new file). Refuses game-file writes while an editor is open; use Beckett then.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Read git status and tracked diff; untracked files are listed, not included in diff.

tools.name: start_job
tools.description: Start/idempotently recover a Godot validation or Blender generation job. One job at a time. Blender script is trusted Python, not sandboxed. Read job logs with job.

tools.name: job
tools.description: Get persistent job state and bounded sanitized log. Poll sparingly; unknown after restart needs inspection, never automatic replay.

tools.name: beckett_tools
tools.description: Discover allowed live Godot MCP tool schemas. Optional name returns only that tool.

tools.name: beckett_call
tools.description: Call an allowed Beckett tool in the open Godot editor. Inspect before editing; edits must target this project.
